(2) the internal fix: per-slice read-pointer copies (cdc_ch AFW=1: ot_qwen_async_fifo_w, as A2) | current flow: TC route (OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC, tt_overlay, CTS fix hooks), mm route hold repair at HM 10 with the HM guard, route-time FF hold at io_ref_routed (route-ff-ioref), early-fail gates; Qwen IO referenced in-run to the block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc: the same variant's insertion; no calibrate)
